name: World Events
overview: Scripture reveals that world events will include unprecedented tribulation and challenges, urging believers to remain vigilant and prayerful as they await Christ's return. Jesus promises peace that transcends worldly troubles and encourages His followers not to conform to the patterns of this world but to be transformed by renewing their minds. Though believers will face hardships in the world, they can take heart in Christ's victory over all things and stand firm in His peace.
